summary: Harden auth cookies (HttpOnly + Secure) and align docs
description: Both createServerClient calls in lib/auth/supabase.ts omit cookieOptions, so @supabase/ssr defaults to httpOnly:false with no Secure flag and any XSS can read the sb-*-auth-token refresh token. README, knowledge/patterns/auth-session.md, ADR-E003, and ARCH claim the cookie is HttpOnly/Secure. Add cookieOptions { httpOnly:true, secure: production, sameSite:lax, path:\/\" } to the server and proxy clients and correct the docs. Note @supabase/ssr forces maxAge to 400 days."
acceptance_criteria: Set-Cookie for sb-*-auth-token includes HttpOnly; includes Secure in production; docs match the emitted flags; a unit test asserts the cookie attributes.

summary: Guard auth:seed against production password resets
description: scripts/seed-auth.mjs only refuses when NODE_ENV=production, but npm does not set NODE_ENV. A rerun calls updateUserById with the shared SEED_AUTH_PASSWORD and email_confirm:true for every existing matching user. Require an explicit opt-in flag (or SEED_AUTH_ALLOW_PRODUCTION), create-only by default, a separate --reset-passwords flag, and verify the Supabase/DB host is local before any write.
acceptance_criteria: A non-local host without the explicit flag exits non-zero before any write; a rerun does not silently reset existing passwords; create-only default is documented.

summary: Use local-scope sign-out on deny-identity paths
description: The unconfirmed/unlinked/DB-error branches in app/(auth)/login/actions.ts and app/auth/callback/route.ts call default signOut() and swallow errors. Global scope returns early on a retryable network/5xx error and leaves the session intact. Use signOut({ scope: \local\" }) in both files and log failures with logger.warn instead of .catch(() => undefined)."
acceptance_criteria: Every deny-identity branch requests local scope; a thrown revoke is logged and the redirect still happens; tests cover the unlinked and unconfirmed branches.

summary: Map a malformed auth URL to the config notice
description: isAuthConfigured() only checks that values are non-empty, but createServerClient throws on an invalid URL. The login action rethrows non-AuthConfigurationError and the callback route constructs the client with no try, so a typo yields a 500 instead of the documented configuration state. Validate the URL in authCredentials() (new URL, require http/https) or wrap construction and map to CONFIG_ERROR / ?error=config.
acceptance_criteria: A malformed NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL shows the configuration notice on /login and redirects /auth/callback with ?error=config; neither path returns a 500.

summary: Map provider sign-in error codes to user messages
description: app/(auth)/login/actions.ts ignores signInError. With email confirmation enabled Supabase returns email_not_confirmed and no user, so the user is told the password is wrong; rate limits and transient 5xx are also reported as bad credentials. Branch on signInError.code: email_not_confirmed -> UNCONFIRMED_ERROR; rate-limit/network -> UNAVAILABLE_ERROR; invalid_credentials/no user -> CREDENTIALS_ERROR.
acceptance_criteria: Each provider error code maps to the correct message; tests cover email_not_confirmed, rate limit, and invalid credentials.

summary: Add tests for signIn and the auth callback handler
description: No automated test imports signIn or the callback GET. Every fail-closed branch added by E2-02 (unconfirmed, unlinked, DB lookup failure, unconfirmed after exchange) is uncovered, so a refactor could drop the email_confirmed_at check or the findUserByEmail mapping and the gate would still pass. Mock createSupabaseServerClient and findUserByEmail and assert each branch returns the right message, calls signOut, and only redirects for a confirmed linked identity.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover signIn and callback for unconfirmed, unlinked, DB error, and success; each asserts signOut is called on deny and redirect only on success.

description: proxy.ts lists /forbidden in PUBLIC_AUTH_PATHS and the docs say it is reachable without a session, but app/(app)/forbidden/page.tsx calls requireSession(). An unauthenticated GET returns 200 with a meta-refresh to /login instead of a 307 or the forbidden content. Either remove /forbidden from PUBLIC_AUTH_PATHS so the proxy 307s it, or render a session-free signed-out state and update knowledge/patterns/auth-session.md and AGENTS.md.
acceptance_criteria: The proxy behaviour and the page behaviour agree; an unauthenticated /forbidden yields one documented outcome; pattern and AGENTS docs match.

summary: Remove or document canAccessPath dead code
description: lib/auth/session.ts exports canAccessPath, but nothing calls it after proxy.ts stopped doing authorization. Either delete it or keep it only if E2-03 will use it, with a test and a comment naming the intended consumer.
acceptance_criteria: canAccessPath is removed, or has a named consumer, a test, and a comment; no unused export remains without justification.
